provider.description: `s3_compatible` covers Hetzner, IONOS, Scaleway, Wasabi, Backblaze B2, MinIO and Google Cloud Storage (HMAC keys).

region.description: `s3`: the AWS region, from which the endpoint is derived. `s3_compatible`: the region the provider signs with (`us-east-1` when omitted).

jurisdiction.description: `r2`: `eu` for a bucket in the EU jurisdiction.

force_path_style.description: `s3_compatible`: address the bucket in the path instead of the host name.

prefix.description: Folder every key is written below; a trailing slash is added.

key_template.description: Object key below the prefix, with `{workspace}`, `{template}`, `{environment}`, `{render_id}`, `{job_id}`, `{yyyy}`, `{mm}`, `{dd}` and `{filename}`. A placeholder without a value (`{template}` of an HTML render, `{render_id}` of a batch zip) drops its segment.

environments.description: Which renders are copied; test renders only when `test` is listed.

public_base_url.description: Where you serve the bucket, https only; each delivery's `url` is built from it.

access_key_id.description: Write-only. Needed for a new connection or a changed endpoint.
